notes.title: Offline Leveling, 90+ Achievements, and New Rocks!
notes.content:
Patch Notes - v1.1.7

Offline Leveling

Players now gain experience for up to 8 hours while offline.
A new window on game launch will display offline progress earned.
Rock Collections will also receive experience while offline.

Achievements

Added 90+ new achievements to unlock. Most of which are from purchasing the cosmetic rocks.
You may experience quite a few achievement unlocks on first startup.

New Rock

Introducing SONDER, purchasable for 4800 ST.
3 cosmetics for SONDER are now also available for 4800 ST each.

Cosmetic Purchase Changes

Removed the ability to purchase rock cosmetics with OB.
This change ensures achievements can’t be unlocked with real money.
Remaining OB can still be used in future Rock Pass collections or additions.

Limited-Time Event

Event Period: April 23 – April 29.
Enjoy +100% level speed during the event.

notes.title: The Weight of Stillness
notes.content:
Steam Idler Festival

Rock Simulator 2 is being featured in the Steam Idler Fest from February 3rd to 10th! During the event, you can get the game for 50% off—the biggest discount ever offered. Plus, on February 4th, the franchise's biggest update will drop, bringing new features and content to elevate your rock experience. Don't miss your chance to dive into the world of stillness and discovery!

Upcoming Patch Notes – Rock Simulator 2

Major Updates
    
        Rock Pass Collection One: Introducing 50 reward tiers for 900 obsidian, featuring: 

            
Permanent 10% level speed boost            
3 new environments: Cave, Quarry, and Dark Forest            
28 new rocks (11 upgradable)            
6 new ambient sounds            
600 obsidian and 30,000 stones
Rock Pass Collections do not expire and will always be available.

Steam Features: Trading cards, emotes, badges, and backgrounds are pending Steam approval.
        
    
10 Trading Cards    
6 Steam Badges which are earned by collecting all trading cards            
5 Rock Emotes            
3 Steam Profile Backgrounds                          

Features & Improvements


Gameplay & World Updates

    
Updated Engine version from UE 5.0 to UE 5.4    
Event multiplier functionality with customizable pulsing level bar    
Adjusted time and weather settings on several maps    
Sky and weather systems updated    
Attempted fix for invisible multiplayer rocks (pending results)

UI Enhancements

    
New item-earned display  
Colorblind settings added for accessibility    
You can now search and hide collection sets in the Catalog panel  
Overhauled leaderboard UI with clickable Steam profiles   
Rocks on the Index panel are now smaller    
Updated leveling panel to support the Rock Pass, events, and artifact system    
Added Rock Simulator X link in the main menu - Give it a follow!

Audio Improvements

    
New main menu music    
Ambient audio panel updated, and audio now loops correctly

notes.title: The Future of RS2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Let's discuss my plans and ideas for this title. Nothing is set in stone here so feel free to give me your best ideas.

Rock Pass
This is a top priority for me and the game, it provides additional content and provides extra revenue for me to continue making this game. 

How will it work?
When the pass is introduced it will contain content that can only be earned during the duration of the pass. After the seasonal pass content is removed, players will no longer be able to earn the rewards it contains. Players that have earned the rewards will keep them forever. This is the typical 'pass' seen in other games.

I expect the cost of the Rock Pass to be 950 Obsidian (Around $6 USD) The pass will include 50+ Reward tiers. Seasonal content will remain in rotation for around 90 days. At the time of writing this, there is not a free tier.

Ascend Update
This is an idea I have had for a while. It will include the notorius 'Ascend map' free for everyone. along with a more difficult set of challenges to complete.

With this update, I would like to introduce an 'Artifact' that will allow players to infinitely increase the level speed using excess Stones.

Optional Voice Chat
This is still on the bottom of the priority list BUT it is something that I would love to add. To be clear this will never be required and can be toggled off at any time.

DLC
DLC is a good place for me to continue the development of the game for years. These will most likely be map packs that can be purchased in-game for Obsidian. These will include their own rewards and challenges.

Let me know what you think about these features and throw your own ideas out as well. I look forward to the future of RS2!

Thank you! vinoo
